scanNotes: 2026-10-24: Searched upcoming entertainment through 23 December and Indian events through February 2027. Partial coverage only; no recurring dates inferred.

Added three verified listings: Balcanto, its separately timed closing concert (6 November), and Mwita Mataro & Band (25 November). Dates, admission and locations confirmed by the festival and MQ organiser programmes.

Rechecked Am Himmel, City Jam, Glow (successful retry), Karawoke, all five retained MQ winter records, eight Charlie P’s records, three American Improv dates, Prater Halloween and UTSAV. Replaced obsolete MQ winter URLs with accessible individual event links.
MQ opening sources differ: individual page lists 18:00 with first music at 18:30; general programme and press text give 18:30. Both times are disclosed in the event details.
Removed the completed 23 October Happy Friday occurrence, which ended at 03:00 on 24 October. Its future occurrence and stable ID remain.
All three American Improv pages display both waiting-list notices and external Meetup booking links; Meetup availability was not verified. Updated November’s caveat accordingly.

Comedy Pub directory and Comedy Factory page were inaccessible; retained all five future Comedy Pub records with unchanged checked dates. The American Improv directory was inaccessible, but individual pages were checked successfully. mdw and Wintermarkt individual sources were not rechecked and retain prior checked dates.

The city Balcanto page returned 500; the official festival HTML and timetable supplied verification. Imperial brunch booking returned no usable contents; price and booking conditions could not be confirmed, so it was not added.
Searches for cinema/theatre, fireworks, Indian artists/celebrations and nearby events produced no further fully verified additions. No claim of complete coverage.
